name: The Rothschild household at 2112 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_rothschild_mrs_m_m

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2112 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2112 Mrs. M. M. Rothschild & dr.; Jesse Rothschild.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2112, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. A house of this kind kept live-in staff, and the 1900 and 1910 censuses name them; neither was read for this card, so no staff are listed. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Miss Rothschild
persons.note: The Blue Book prints '& dr.' after the household's name: an unmarried daughter at home, not named. 'Miss Rothschild' is the book's own form of address, not a recorded name.

persons.name: Jesse Rothschild
persons.note: A son is read from the shared surname under the head's listing; the Blue Book does not state the relationship.
